plan.title: Hallmark GSEA: psoriasis lesional vs control
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question asks only which hallmark pathways change between the treated (psoriasis lesional) and control skin samples. Differential expression is already done: /eval-full-32-with-enrichment-only-ranked-2/data/inputs/results/de_results.csv holds a DESeq2 results table for the treated vs control contrast over 12,000 genes with base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fold_change SE, and the columns needed to rank. So no DE step is re-planned — the counts matrix (12,000 x 13, first column gene symbol, 12 samples) and metadata (12 x 2, condition) are used only for a light sanity check that the supplied results table matches the stated 6 treated vs 6 control design and to record the flagged low-depth sample (sample_01, library size ~4x below median), not to refit a model.

Step T1S1 validates and prepares the ranking: it confirms the de_results.csv column set, checks the direction convention of the contrast against the metadata condition labels (a sign error silently inverts every pathway call), quantifies how many genes carry a usable test statistic versus NA (DESeq2 sets p to NA for Cook's-distance outliers at n<7 per group and for independently filtered genes), reports how many genes pass padj<0.05, and writes one ranked vector over ALL tested genes. The ranking metric is the disputed choice named by the knowledge service: the Wald statistic (stat), i.e. the log2 fold change divided by its standard error — chosen because it scales the effect by its uncertainty, which the unshrunken log2FC alone does not, and because it does not tie at the top the way a signed p-value does. If de_results.csv carries no stat column, it is reconstructed as log2_fold_change / lfcSE and that substitution is reported.

Step T2S1 runs the actual question: fgsea preranked GSEA of that full ranked list against the human MSigDB hallmark collection (50 HALLMARK_* sets, HGNC symbols), restricted to sets with 15-500 members after intersection with the tested genes, BH-adjusted, with leading-edge genes retained and overlapping significant sets collapsed so that redundant hits are not counted as separate findings. The gene identifier space in both the counts file and the results table is gene symbol, which matches the collection's identifier space directly; symbols that do not intersect any hallmark set are counted and reported rather than dropped silently.

Step T1S2 writes the report: the ranked hallmark table with NES, padj and leading edge, the direction of each significant set stated in terms of treated (lesional) versus control, plus the reproducibility record — collection name and version, rank metric, universe, size window, permutation seed, package versions. Psoriasis lesional skin has a strong, well-known interferon/TNF/IL-17 inflammatory program, so a hallmark result showing inflammatory and keratinocyte-proliferation sets up is the expected outcome and is not independent confirmation of anything; the report states hallmark hits as hypotheses whose ranking is method-dependent, not as established mechanism. n=6 per group with one low-depth sample is adequate for a hallmark-level readout but not for confident claims about individual weakly-changed sets.
